title: Employee Authorization
description: Authorizes an individual to act on behalf of an organization. Issued by an organization's identity agent to an employee's personal identity agent. The employee presents this credential to prove organizational affiliation.

u.description: Salt, when the credential is issued private

i.description: Issuer: the identity that issued the credential

ri.description: The registry the credential is issued in, where its revocation is recorded

u.description: Salt, when the attributes are issued private

employee_name.description: Full legal name of the employee

role.description: Employee's role or title within the organization

permissions.description: Specific permissions granted (e.g. verify_credentials, sign_contracts, manage_employees)

oneOf.description: Edges: the credentials this one rests on, each by its identifier and schema
